narrative.overview: A readable game toolbelt inside a derelict workshop. Worn industrial artwork and the approved distressed Dead Signal Interactive logo carry the atmosphere; instructions and native controls stay quiet, clear and intact. The user rejected green and creature imagery.

rules.name: The Quiet Controls Rule
rules.body: Keep texture in imagery and solid surfaces behind live instructions and controls.

rules.name: The Literal State Rule
rules.body: Show connection and god-mode claims only from actual tool results; decoration never stands in for evidence.

dos: Do preserve the approved distressed logo PNG exactly.
Do describe the next useful game action in plain language.
Do keep technical output collapsed and inline Lua in the advanced tab.
donts: Don't introduce green or creature figures.
Don't distress instructions, field text or controls.
Don't turn mod creation, folder selection or saved scenarios into connection prerequisites.
